stories.title: The Bulwark Now Wants You To Forget 2024
stories.text: After my essay and live chat on how the former GOP operatives behind The Bulwark are trying to steer Democrats’ agenda, the news outlet has been scrambling to try to fortify its reputation as experts in winning elections, knowing that is their fraudulent-but-unique selling proposition to liberals. In the process, founder Sarah Longwell is now trying to rewrite the entire history of the 2024 election, pretending that neocons’ success in influencing the Democrats’ strategy in that contest had no real impact on the outcome — when in fact data suggest it helped deliver the presidency to Donald Trump. “My problem with the DSA types who are after us is not their political ideology or their opinions,” said Longwell, amid the social media uproar over my essay at The Lever . “Their analysis doesn’t make any sense.
